text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of training with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.
Long after our appointed meeting time had passed...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Waaaahhhhh!!
I'm sorry, I'm so, so sorryyyy!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I tried out a new meditation technique,
and my consciousness just drifted completely away...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that she was truly remorseful,
I simply told her to make sure it didn't happen again.
